description: Online tools: count words, make QR codes, generate passwords, format JSON and calculate loan EMI — all in your browser, no sign-up.

defaultPrompt: Count the words in this paragraph for me
Make a QR code for https://mamatool.com
interface.longDescription: MamaTool is a set of 50+ tools that run entirely in your browser — no sign-up, no uploads, no API keys. This plugin exposes five of them inside ChatGPT: count words, characters, sentences and paragraphs in any text; generate a QR code for a URL or text; generate a secure random password; validate and pretty-print JSON; and calculate a loan EMI with total interest. Everything is computed locally by the plugin server; nothing you type is stored.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.0.0 — initial release. Five read-only tools: word count, QR code generation, secure password generation, JSON formatting, and EMI calculation. No sign-in, no data stored.

positive.prompt: Count the words in this paragraph: [paste about 60 words of text]
positive.expected_behavior: Returns correct word, character and sentence counts.

positive.prompt: Make a QR code for https://mamatool.com
